# Phone mockup

**Status:** decorative. **Category:** mockups. **In the demo:** `/gallery/mockup-phone`.

This repository's rules come first. Where this page disagrees with [Standards](../standards.md) or
[AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md), they win: no CDN, no npm, no images from other servers, no inline `style` or `onclick`.
Use the [macros](../../../app/ui/templates/ui/macros.html) where one exists.

A phone mockup shows an iPhone mockup.

[Phone mockup documentation](https://daisyui.com/components/mockup-phone/)

## Class names
- component: `mockup-phone`
- part: `mockup-phone-camera`, `mockup-phone-display`

## Syntax
```html
<div class="mockup-phone">
  <div class="mockup-phone-camera"></div>
  <div class="mockup-phone-display">{CONTENT}</div>
</div>
```

## Rules
- You can put content in `mockup-phone-display`.
